notes.title: Game Update - Early Access: Fully Loaded!
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539706/79547cb53b2407c1c4cb7da87d71e8d84510cbd0.jpg"]
August game update is live! Here are the highlights: 
Pledge allegiance to a Faction, raise your reputation & unlock faction drip
Going deeper into the Faction lore, the full faction Reputation system unlocks next release

New Battle Zone: Big Carrot Energy Stadium
Explore the Rogue Jumpers faction area in Hangout and competitive modes.

Updated Skateboard Physics
It’s way more physical now


Skateboard and Water Pistol Skins added to the game
Change your skins in the inventory 

All reload animations are now hooked up and in the game
Certain weapons can now be interrupted and only half reloaded

Weapon Movement Speed Modifiers added
Weapons now impact your movement speed, helps melee weapons the most


Melee Weapons Buffed
Attack mid-air with the improved leap and cut the distance to enemies at ease


Performance Improvements
Your average FPS should slightly higher all around now


Founders Pass has been removed from menu
We transition to a new Faction Progression system in the next release


Let us know on discord how you feel about the updates:https://discord.gg/wMpCE6qSEsPS. Show your support and wishlist the game on Steam
